title: Record Nanoleaf native controls and accept discovered scenes
body:
Refs jimmie-potts/codex-nanoleaf#64. Companion to [codex-nanoleaf PR #66](https://github.com/jimmie-potts/codex-nanoleaf/pull/66), merged as `80628498136203a8f5fcb06ab5fa306e961e2def` (reviewed head `468b797`, identical tree); its nine merged-main checks passed and Nanoleaf #64 is closed as completed.

## Changes

- `apps/hub/src/integration.ts`: the exact-shape `validateIntegrationSnapshot` accepts an optional `scenes` list (opaque `scene-<64 hex>` ids, optional user-chosen names of 1 to 80 characters, at most 256 entries). Without this a hub built from `main` rejects every extension snapshot from a Nanoleaf source at or after #66.
- `apps/hub/tests/integration.test.mjs`: accepts a valid list and rejects over-long names, non-opaque ids, extra keys and 257 entries.
- `apps/hub/fixtures/nanoleaf-source.json` and `compatibility-nanoleaf-source.json`: re-pinned to `8062849` with fresh SHA-256 hashes of the listed source files; `scripts/check-hub-nanoleaf.mjs` receipt literal updated to the same revision.
- `docs/cross-device-compatibility.md`: records the rerun of the bounded compatibility suite against Hub `36090dd`, Pixoo `28f4875` and Nanoleaf `8062849`.
- Work guide: backlogs, native dependencies and paginated history refreshed after the closure; N64 moved from open coverage, the general-controls timeline node and the parallel units to a completed reference in the controls guide; `refresh_backlogs.py` adds #64 as a reference-only direct read; dated `updates.md` entry with the no-diagram reason; HTML regenerated.

## Validation at `055aafc6c141ee63ae5c166aadccc51ccaed185c`

title: Add Pixoo general controls to the BUNNY component view
body:
The BUNNY component view exposed only Monitor/Media and monitor settings for Pixoo, although the Pixoo controller already declares screen power, brightness and media on controller v1. This adds those general controls to the same view under ADR 0005. Refs #151.

Screen power, brightness, saved-playlist selection and the six declared playback actions appear in the Pixoo view and work without an observed session. Each control submits one guarded controller v1 command through the existing hub route with the snapshot's request ticket, configuration revision and generation. Availability follows the declared capability, the credential's control scope and the Pixoo mode; every disabled control names the missing capability, scope, stale evidence or mode. Playlist and playback controls are disabled in Monitor or while a mode change is pending, with a one-click explicit "Switch to Media" through the mode control. No command changes the mode as a side effect, nothing restores automatically, and uncertain results stay locked until the user loads current values. Playlists are listed by ID until Pixoo #67.

One recorded reassessment: Pixoo `main` c81bc31 declares controller v1 modes unsupported and accepts Monitor/Media only through its integration extension, while the delivered fixture declared v1 modes. The Pixoo mode control and the explicit switch now use the integration `mode` operation, and the fake Pixoo declares the real capabilities. Nanoleaf still declares only Work/Quiet/Free, so its general controls render disabled with reasons until Nanoleaf #64 and #153.

Scope: `apps/dashboard` source, fixtures, browser scenarios and evidence; a hub test that general commands are validated and scoped before any controller request; dashboard, development, architecture and README notes; OpenSpec change `gh-151-pixoo-general-controls` with the `unified-dashboard` delta. The hub route, controller v1 contract and Pixoo extension are unchanged. No hook, installation, agent session, state migration or device operation. Physical acceptance is #154.

Acceptance evidence at 8790d51, repeated at 259efd8, on Node 24.13.0: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, 6 dashboard unit tests, the full browser suite and the nine-scenario matrix (four new #151 scenarios: guarded commands in Media with keyboard submission, Monitor gating with the explicit switch and a pending mode, concurrent edits with a typed conflict and a locked uncertain action, read-only and undeclared reasons with axe at desktop and 390px), 71 hub tests, 19 setup tests, the reproducible hub package, hub MCP, workflow checks, and the unchanged contract, lifecycle, agent-state and MCP suites in both languages. The `generalReasons` unit test and the matrix scenarios failed before the UI change and pass after it. Committed receipts are under `apps/dashboard/evidence`; screenshots stay outside Git.

Risk: incorrect commands can change what the display shows. Bounded by schema validation before forwarding, the controller's revision and generation guards, per-device serialization, typed conflicts and locked uncertain results. Transport receipts are never presented as physical results.

Frozen comparison for review round 1: base and merge-base `2313df867dc5f4127b27da43d7984b3f23490e5b`, head `69783d955cbada2682c77c649dd333d8dcfdffa1`, `git diff 2313df8..69783d9`, clean worktree, 31 files. The head adds the spec sync and archive (`2026-09-22-gh-151-pixoo-general-controls`; workflow checks report 11 specifications, no active changes, 13 archives) and the work-guide refresh: backlogs and paginated history at 2026-09-22T14:52Z, Hub #151 in review, Nanoleaf #64's candidate PR #66 recorded, HTML SHA-256 `685d9040864536449381d923d51ae306b60cb88c72744cf65409ebe2608eb1cd`, nine maintenance tests and browser/print checks passing, no generated drift. This is a mixed change, so every configured CI job applies.

Review round 1 on 69783d9 returned no P0-P1 findings. Standards required changes for two P2s (STD-1: a rejected one-click ticket could adopt another client's receipt as its outcome; STD-2: unknown brightness rendered as 100%) with four P3s; Specification approved with dispositions for two P2s (SPEC-1: the reassessed Pixoo mode transport was not pinned in the spec or the issue's scope sentence; SPEC-2: actions re-enabled before the refreshed ticket) and two P3s. The Dashboard CI job on 69783d9 failed on an axe color-contrast violation, reproduced locally by hovering a secondary button: 1.01:1 on the existing hover background.

Round 2 comparison: base and merge-base `2313df867dc5f4127b27da43d7984b3f23490e5b`, head `259efd88cca63b91e49124aba87ca9335075b1dc`, fix diff `git diff 69783d9..259efd8`. Fixes: one-click actions watch only accepted tickets and stay busy until the refreshed snapshot arrives; the brightness draft uses desired, then observed evidence and says when the current brightness is unknown; forms and the media group carry accessible names; a missing playlist is a named reason; secondary buttons keep contrast on hover; axe failures name their nodes; the matrix drops the test-only attribute, captures fixture revisions, and adds regressions for the rejected-ticket case, rapid successive actions, focus across reconnect and unknown brightness; the archived design and proposal match the shipped behavior; both spec copies pin the Pixoo mode transport. STD-3 (inert outcome lookup for the integration switch) is proposed as an accepted P3: the switch reports the integration response and the mode change is visible in the refreshed snapshot. SPEC-1 still needs the issue owner's disposition on #151's scope sentence, which this PR records as the accepted reassessment rather than editing the issue. Round 2 fix-verification reviews on 259efd8 and current-head CI follow.

Round 2 fix verification on 259efd8: both independent axes approve with P3 dispositions and no regressions. Standards: STD-1, STD-2, STD-4 and STD-5 resolved with red-capable coverage; STD-6 half resolved (accessible form and group names added; disabled reasons remain sibling hints rather than `aria-describedby` targets). Specification: SPEC-2, SPEC-3 and SPEC-4 resolved; SPEC-1 resolved in the spec and archived proposal, with the issue wording left to the issue owner. Recorded P3 dispositions, owner hub frontend maintenance, none blocking: STD-3 the integration switch's terminal-outcome lookup is inert (the switch reports the integration response and the refreshed snapshot shows the mode); STD-6 residual and STD-8 duplicate `form` landmark names for per-session Label and per-notice acknowledgment forms (`landmark-unique` is a best-practice rule outside the WCAG tags the suites scan); STD-7 acceptance is inferred from an absent `failure` field although the contract allows `failed`/`cancelled`/`uncertain` receipts without one (no controller in this repository produces such a receipt); SPEC-5 the missing-playlist reason is not exercised by a fixture; SPEC-6 the heterogeneous-components scenario relies on the synthetic sensor injected by the main browser suite rather than a third fixture controller. Test-quality notes retained: no test hovers before an axe scan; the unknown-brightness midpoint equals the unsupported fallback on a 0–100 range.

Hosted checks at 259efd8: five of six jobs passed on run 35745319532 and 35745320113. The Dashboard job failed in the unchanged "slow device" scenario: its direct wall snapshot read returned 429 from the hub's single per-device slot while the dashboard's periodic wall poll was in flight. The scenario passed on the previous head and in repeated local runs, and the log does not connect it to the changed code, so one evidence-supported rerun of the failed job was used for this head and failure signature (allowance 1 of 1). The rerun (attempt 2) passed. Readback at 259efd8: all six check runs completed with success, Checks run 35745319532 attempt 2 and Work guide run 35745320113; PR mergeable, merge state clean.

UI approval scope: the changed UI is the Pixoo component view under `apps/dashboard` (general controls, Pixoo mode control). It is not guide UI, so explicit human approval of this exact candidate is required and is currently pending. Desktop and mobile screenshots of the Media and Monitor states were delivered to the owner outside Git.

Remaining completion work: independent Standards and Specification reviews of the frozen comparison, all six current-head CI jobs, explicit human approval of the actual UI candidate under the SDLC UI approval scope (screenshots delivered to the owner; renewed after any UI change), the work-guide entry, OpenSpec sync and archive, guarded squash merge, merged-main CI readback and issue closure.

title: Record 85HA keyboard and N30 mouse qualification findings
body:
The owner's packaging identifies an 8BitDo N Edition keyboard (85HA) and N30 mouse (85CA). The earlier R8 research lead does not describe this mouse. This candidate records the actual hardware, cited per-control/per-connection capabilities, Windows/Wispr/Codex interfaces, mapping ownership and a reversible operator trial.

Refs #64. This is the source-evidence candidate; #64 remains incomplete and #65 remains blocked. The keyboard's genuine held output, N30 event identities/selective suppression, installed app versions and a complete supported route are unqualified. No input observer, mapping write, microphone use, app dispatch or installation ran. Read-only Windows inventory failed because this session could not execute Windows tools.

The canonical desktop-control document and generated guide incorporate the new evidence. Guide inputs reconcile concurrent #63 closure and merged source history. Public guide publication remains separate.

Validation on the committed candidate:

- Node 24: `npm run check:workflow` and `npm run test:workflow` passed; 11 specifications, 10 archives and 15 workflow tests. This documentation introduces no behavior or wire-contract delta, so no new OpenSpec capability is needed.
- `python3 docs/work-guide/work/test_maintenance.py`: all five tests passed.
- `node docs/work-guide/work/check_guide.cjs`: coverage, links, navigation, interactions and print restoration passed at six widths. Desktop/mobile/print renders were inspected. The guide covers 95 open issues, 130 linked issues, 52 roadmap nodes and nine diagrams.
- All nine Archify artifacts passed 9/9 deterministic checks; guide regeneration produced no drift. The standalone desktop-input viewer still fails its viewport check for vertical overflow, with identical dimensions and diagnostics to the previous artifact. This existing limitation is retained, not reported as a pass.

Independent Standards and Specification reviews, including Windows/input compatibility, and all six applicable hosted jobs are pending. Merge eligibility depends on their results and the missing qualification evidence; this PR has no automatic issue-closure keyword. Source work does not establish installed, application or physical acceptance.
